config.description: Vitest configuration file the run loads, relative to the workspace root, whose folder the run starts from

projects.description: Vitest projects the task runs, passed as --project, every project the configuration resolves where empty

attachmentsDir.description: Folder the task's projects write attachments to, relative to the workspace root, the run's attachmentsDir where the task runs alone

__unparsed__.description: Words after -- of the run, parsed as vitest run arguments

title: Test
description: Runs vitest run in a child process of its own once over the projects of every batched task sharing a configuration and its options, one Vite server and one worker pool the configuration's maxWorkers sizes, side by side with the runs of other option groups, and decides each task from the test modules of its own projects
